The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 73db2ee4a6d9f8ad), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. statement: Let X/C be a smooth projective connected curve, let x ∈ X, and put U = X\{x}. Let G be simple and simply connected, and let B be either of the two level stacks just defined. Suppose that a locally bounded constructible geometric E-adic complex F on B has a coherent Hecke eigenstructure for a Zariski-dense parameter σ on U. For every j ∈ Z, the perverse cohomology pHj(F) has an induced coherent eigenstructure with the same parameter and has singular support in Λ. This structure is natural in representations and compatible with the unit, convolution, permutations, and all collision diagonals in every UI. If F ̸= 0, at least one of these perverse eigensheaves is nonzero. No common bound on the cohomological degrees of F over B is required.
